CHOICE: 3
CONFIDENCE: 3

I checked the two examples in Solution 3 directly. In $C_p\times C_p$, the $p+1\ge 3$ subgroups of order $p$ are pairwise co-maximal, which gives girth 3. In $C_{36}$, two subgroups are adjacent exactly when their orders have lcm 36, so the vertices of order 4 and 12 are adjacent to those of order 9 and 18 and nothing else. That is $K_{2,2}=C_4$, so girth 4 occurs. Solutions 1 and 2 both claim a girth-5 or girth-6 example, and I found no support for either. The impossibility of girth $\ge 5$ in Solution 3 is only partly verified. I did not check its reduction argument step by step, so my confidence is moderate.
